text:
Asha: Hey — thinking about an after-work happy hour next Friday. Rooftop picnic at The Dock, or a nearby craft cocktail bar? Quick thumbs on vibe.
Kenji: Rooftop please! :sun_with_face:
Riley: In if it’s outdoors. 6:30 start ok?
Priya: Love rooftop but might have family dinner — I’m a maybe. :thinking_face:
Marcus: I can check The Dock availability (they hold 20). If they want a deposit I can put it down.
Elaine: I’ll do a tiny poll so we can pick venue + time.
EventBot: POLL created by Elaine: Where should we meet? (react with :one:, :two:, :three:)
• 1) The Dock rooftop (outdoor)
• 2) Noble Street (craft cocktails)
• 3) Meeples Cafe (board games + snacks)
Asha: Quick strawpoll too: https://strawpoll.example/afterwork-123
Kenji: Rain plan -> Noble Street.
Riley: /rsvp yes
Priya: /rsvp maybe + dairy allergy
Marcus: /rsvp yes. I’ll volunteer to book if we get 8 yeses.
Elaine: I can grab snacks (chips, veggie platter). Any volunteers for non-alc drinks?
Zack: I’ll bring mocktails.
Asha: RSVP shorthand for everyone: `/rsvp yes|no|maybe + notes` — helps me track.
Kenji: /rsvp yes
Riley: /rsvp yes
Priya: noted — will confirm by Wed morning if family ok
Marcus: If we hit 10 yeses I’ll put down the deposit and reserve the rooftop for 6:30–9pm.
Elaine: Also checking vegetarian options at Noble Street in case we pivot.
Zack: earlier start preferred for me (6:15 ok?), but 6:30 workable.
Asha: Final decision Wednesday 15:00. If we don't hit 8 yeses, fallback is Noble Street.
Kenji: :thumbsup:
Riley: :raised_hands:
EventBot: Reminder scheduled: "Book rooftop if 8+ yes by 2027-05-05 15:00"
Asha: Thanks all — keeping this thread open for RSVPs and snack volunteers.
